result: Passed within the documented scope; index-only QA patch awaits Azhosting deployment.

changes: Recovery redirect expectation follows the current deployment origin.
Independent card/reset backends handle the two exact anonymous visitor RPC contracts without permitting unrelated writes.

additionalCases.name: Untrusted listing text remains text in cards and details
Empty filtered results show the empty state without a network error

browser.network: Automated regression backends use intercepted synthetic responses; they do not exercise real account or listing writes.

database.transactionPolicy: Synthetic fixtures inside BEGIN…ROLLBACK; no COMMIT or external provider calls.
database.legacyFixtureChanges: Legacy business-rule fixtures isolate the separately tested photo gate within the rolled-back transaction; positive package fixtures use the current 10 AZN / 15 day price.

liveAndPreviewChecks.visitorRecordingDuringPreview: Intercepted; live checks use read-only data and do not inflate the public visitor total.

productFixes: Use an inline SVG for the hero arrow to avoid missing-glyph squares with fallback fonts.
Remove the stale cabinet note claiming that SMS, database and secure login must be connected before launch.

existingFindings.context: Existing default-deny tables; this audit does not remove their protection.
Existing authenticated admin/package entry points retain server-side authorization checks; the warning baseline remains open.
Leaked-password protection remains disabled; no plan upgrade or Auth configuration change was made.

limitations: Automatic bank/card payments are not connected; package requests and admin confirmation remain the available flow.
Real new-domain SMTP delivery and password change were confirmed earlier by the owner; this QA run did not send another email or change a real password.
This is not a production load test or a guarantee that all possible security issues are closed.
Local scratch evidence paths refer to retained workspace logs, not public release assets.

deployment.status: QA patch ready; not yet deployed to Azhosting
